notes.title: 'Hot' fix 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello pizza delivery enthusiasts!

First of all, happy Cosmonautics day! To celebrate it we've prepared a small update for you.

Patchnotes (1.0.2):

[list]
[*] Sputnik Λ has been added in levels 2 - 7 and 9. A new type of Sputnik that will not kill you, but instead vaccinate your character and make it known to everyone else!
[*] A hidden achievement has been added. Interact with a Sputnik Λ to see what happens.
[*] Steam Achievements. Some achievements were not being unlocked, this is now fixed (we hope).
[*] Sound Control in Options. The slider position is now remembered. Also the default value is no longer a 100%.
[*] Various platform position fixes throughout the first chapter.
[/list]

If you found a bug, or have a feature that you want us to implement don't forget to let us know at the 2D Guys Discord [url=https://discord.gg/mV9mWMK]here.[/url]

That is all. Thank you and happy delivering!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello pizza delivery enthusiasts!

We've deployed a fix to some of the bugs.

Patchnotes (1.0.1):

[list]
[*] Omnicluster Free Delivery mode: pizza bag is now accessible.
[*] Omnicluster Free Delivery mode: a number of sprite rendering errors fixed.
[*] Main Menu: menu buttons separated apart for easier visualisation.
[*] Resolution: a work-in-progress fix for screens with larger resolution. Will monitor the monitors (ha-ha)
[*] Small updates in level 1 and level 30
[/list]

Thank you and happy delivering!
